azure-retail-prices.title: Azure Retail Prices API
azure-retail-prices.note: D4s_v5, ND96isr H100 v5 and ND128isr GB200 v6 (Linux, pay-as-you-go), Premium SSD v2 capacity (baseline IOPS and throughput included), Standard data transfer out over the Microsoft network (the default routing), tiered with the first 100 GB free.

oci-price-list.title: Oracle Cloud price list API
oci-price-list.note: Oracle publishes one price list for every commercial region. E5 Flex OCPU and memory, Block Volume at Balanced performance (10 VPU/GB), outbound transfer with the first 10 TB a month free, H100 and B200 per GPU-hour. The price list does not say which regions offer GPU shapes.

aws-prices-ec2.title: AWS EC2 on-demand pricing data (the feed behind aws.amazon.com/ec2/pricing)
aws-prices-ec2.note: m7i.xlarge (m6i.xlarge where m7i is not offered), p5.48xlarge and p6-b200.48xlarge, Linux, per region.

aws-prices-ebs.title: AWS EBS pricing data
aws-prices-ebs.note: gp3 storage per GB-month, per region.

aws-prices-egress.title: AWS Price List API: AWSDataTransfer offer
aws-prices-egress.note: Data transfer out to the internet, tiered, per region; first 100 GB a month free.

gcp-billing-catalog.title: Google Cloud Billing Catalog API: Compute Engine SKUs
gcp-billing-catalog.note: On-demand N2 core and RAM (n2-standard-4 = 4 vCPU + 16 GB), Balanced persistent disk, premium-tier internet egress to the Americas (Google prices egress by destination), H100 GPU plus A3 core and RAM for a3-highgpu-8g, and the A4 B200 one-GPU slice, per region.

basket.general: Per month: a 4 vCPU / 16 GiB Linux VM for 730 hours on demand, 500 GB of general-purpose SSD block storage, and 1 TB (1,024 GB) of internet egress at tiered list rates with free allowances.
basket.gpu: On-demand list price per GPU-hour: an 8 x H100 node, and a Blackwell node (B200, or GB200 where that is the provider's offering), divided by the GPUs in the node.
